24628-the-tale-of-jimmy-rabbit.title: Rabbit
24628-the-tale-of-jimmy-rabbit.creator: Arthur Scott Bailey
24628-the-tale-of-jimmy-rabbit.description: A book by Arthur Scott Bailey. , Jimmy Rabbit often lurked behind trees and bushes, watching his neighbors as they took naps in the sunshine. But when they awaked and stretched themselves, and went trotting off, there was not one of them that didn't take his tail right along with him.

arxiv-2103-11458.title: The Stable Marriage Problem: an Interdisciplinary Review from the Physicist’s Perspective
arxiv-2103-11458.creator: Enrico Maria Fenoaltea*, Izat B. Baybusinov*, Jianyang Zhao**, Lei Zhou**, Yi-Cheng Zhang*
arxiv-2103-11458.description: Abstract We present a fascinating model that has lately caught attention among physicists working in complexity related fields. Though it originated from mathematics and later from economics, the model is very enlightening in many aspects that we shall highlight in this review.

arxiv-2110-09208.title: Correlation-based Discovery of Disease Patterns for Syndromic Surveillance
arxiv-2110-09208.creator: Michael Rapp, Moritz Kulessa, Eneldo Loza Mencía, Johannes Fürnkranz
arxiv-2110-09208.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Michael Rapp, Moritz Kulessa, Eneldo Loza Mencía, Johannes Fürnkranz. Early outbreak detection is a key aspect in the containment of infectious diseases, as it enables the identification and isolation of infected individuals before the disease can spread to a larger population. Instead of detecting unexpected increases of infections by monitoring confirmed cases, syndromic surveillance aims at the detection of cases with early symptoms, which allows a more timely disclosure of outbreaks.

arxiv-2202-06926.title: Role of the companion lensing galaxy in the CLASS gravitational lens B1152+199 2022 Role of the companion lensing galaxy in the CLASS gravitational lens B1152+199 – 8
arxiv-2202-06926.creator: M. Zhang, Q. Yuan, J.-Y. Liu, L. Zhang
arxiv-2202-06926.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by M. Zhang, Q. Yuan, J.-Y. Liu, L. Zhang. We reinvestigate the Cosmic Lens All-Sky Survey ( CLASS ) gravitational lens B1152+199 using archived Hubble Space Telescope ( HST ) data and Very Long Baseline Interferometry ( VLBI ) data. A consistent luminosity ratio within effective radius between the host galaxy and the X-galaxy is measured from HST tri-band images, which leads to a mass ratio between the two galaxies as r b ∼ 2 r_{b}\sim 2 .

arxiv-2202-07994.title: Privacy-preserving Similarity Calculation of Speaker Features Using Fully Homomorphic Encryption
arxiv-2202-07994.creator: Yogachandran Rahulamathavan
arxiv-2202-07994.description: Abstract Recent advances in machine learning techniques are enabling Automated Speech Recognition (ASR) more accurate and practical. The evidence of this can be seen in the rising number of smart devices with voice processing capabilities. More and more devices around us are in-built with ASR technology. This poses serious privacy threats as speech contains unique biometric characteristics and personal data.

arxiv-2305-05271.title: Robust Acoustic and Semantic Contextual Biasing in Neural Transducers for Speech Recognition
arxiv-2305-05271.creator: Xuandi Fu † , Kanthashree Mysore Sathyendra † , Ankur Gandhe, Jing Liu, Grant P. Strimel, Ross McGowan, Athanasios Mouchtaris
arxiv-2305-05271.description: Abstract † † address: Amazon Alexa Attention-based contextual biasing approaches have shown significant improvements in the recognition of generic and/or personal rare-words in End-to-End Automatic Speech Recognition (E2E ASR) systems like neural transducers. These approaches employ cross-attention to bias the model towards specific contextual entities injected as bias-phrases to the model.

arxiv-2310-16817.title: All-optical single-shot readout of a superconducting qubit
arxiv-2310-16817.creator: Georg Arnold ⋆, Thomas Werner ⋆, Rishabh Sahu, Lucky N. Kapoor, Liu Qiu, Johannes M. Fink
arxiv-2310-16817.description: Abstract The rapid development of superconducting quantum hardware is expected to run into significant I/O restrictions due to the need for large-scale error correction in a cryogenic environment Bravyi et al. 2022 ; Beverland et al. 2022 . Classical data centers rely on fiber-optic interconnects to remove similar networking bottlenecks and to allow for reconfigurable, software-defined infrastructures Cheng et al.

arxiv-2312-17711.title: NNLO QCD corrections to semi-inclusive DIS
arxiv-2312-17711.creator: Saurav Goyal, Sven-Olaf Moch, Vaibhav Pathak, Narayan Rana, V. Ravindran
arxiv-2312-17711.description: Abstract We present the first results for the next-to-next-to leading order (NNLO) corrections to the semi-inclusive deep-inelastic scattering process in perturbative quantum chromodynamics. We consider the quark initiated flavor non-singlet process and obtain the complete contributions analytically at leading color.

arxiv-2401-13222.title: It’s About Time: Incorporating Temporality in Retrieval Augmented Language Models
arxiv-2401-13222.creator: Anoushka Gade, Jorjeta Jetcheva
arxiv-2401-13222.description: Abstract . The web serves as a global repository of knowledge, used by billions of people to search for information. Ensuring that users receive the most relevant and up-to-date information, especially in the presence of multiple versions of web content from different time points remains a critical challenge for information retrieval.

arxiv-2412-00796.title: Gaussian quasi-likelihood analysis for non-Gaussian linear mixed-effects model with system noise
arxiv-2412-00796.creator: Takumi Imamura, Hiroki Masuda
arxiv-2412-00796.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Takumi Imamura, Hiroki Masuda. We consider statistical inference for a class of mixed-effects models with a system noise described by a non-Gaussian integrated Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process. Under the asymptotics where the number of individuals goes to infinity with possibly unbalanced sampling frequency across individuals, we prove some theoretical properties of the Gaussian quasi-likelihood function, followed by the asymptotic normality and the tail-probability estimate of the associated estimator.

arxiv-2504-05148.title: Stereo-LiDAR Fusion by Semi-Global Matching with Discrete Disparity-Matching Cost and Semidensification
arxiv-2504-05148.creator: Yasuhiro Yao, Ryoichi Ishikawa, and Takeshi Oishi
arxiv-2504-05148.description: Abstract We present a real-time, non-learning depth estimation method that fuses Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) data with stereo camera input. Our approach comprises three key techniques: Semi-Global Matching (SGM) stereo with Discrete Disparity-matching Cost (DDC), semidensification of LiDAR disparity, and a consistency check that combines stereo images and LiDAR data.

arxiv-2512-07680.title: AMBER: Aerial deployable gripping crawler with compliant microspine for canopy manipulation
arxiv-2512-07680.creator: P. A. Wigner, L. Romanello, A. Hammad, P. H. Nguyen, T. Lan, S. F. Armanini, B. B. Kocer, M. Kovac
arxiv-2512-07680.description: Abstract This paper presents an aerially deployable crawler designed for adaptive locomotion and manipulation within tree canopies. The system combines compliant microspine-based tracks, a dual-track rotary gripper, and an elastic tail, enabling secure attachment and stable traversal across branches of varying curvature and inclination.

britannica-1911-ostade.title: Ostade (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-ostade.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-ostade.description: Article 'Ostade' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 20), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. by no means an indifferent scholar. Having come to London in 1652 he was rightly suspected of sympathizing with the exiled royalists, and in 1655 was put into prison by Cromwell; after his release about a year later he went to Holland and married a Dutch lady of good family, accompanying Charles II.

pmc-10541182.title: Paternal alcohol exposure and dental-facial anomalies in offspring
pmc-10541182.creator: Divya Vinayachandran, Saravana Karthikeyan Balasubramanian
pmc-10541182.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). it is noteworthy that there is no previous research evidence on the role of paternal alcohol exposure in the development of craniofacial abnormalities and related growth deficiencies. Using a multiplex mouse model study, Thomas et al. (1) showed observations, including alcohol-induced changes that predominated in the lower regions of the face, including the maxilla, mandible, and ear positioning, with a shift of midline features to the right, which is in accordance with previous literature (2).

pmc-11351074.title: The management of osteosarcoma in children and adolescents in a resource-limited setting: quality improvement considerations to improve treatment outcomes
pmc-11351074.creator: Richard Nyeko, Fadhil Geriga, Racheal Angom, Joyce Balagadde Kambugu, Jaques van Heerden
pmc-11351074.description: BackgroundThe survival rates for children and adolescents with osteosarcoma in low-income countries are poor. Insufficient data regarding the challenges of managing osteosarcoma in resource-limited settings has been published. We evaluated the treatment of osteosarcoma in children and adolescents with the aim of improving the health system and management outcomes.

pmc-11387363.title: Meta-regression of idiopathic full-thickness macular holes diameter and anatomical closure rate: Implications to intraoperative technique
pmc-11387363.creator: Ruiheng Zhang, Yan-Cheng Fang, Xuhan Shi, Haotian Wu, Chuyao Yu, Yitong Li, Wenda Zhou, Heyan Li, Chuan Zhang, Yan-Feng Zhou, Li Dong, Wenbin Wei
pmc-11387363.description: PurposePrimary surgery failure of macular holes causes poor visual acuity outcomes. Several studies indicate that small-medium idiopathic full-thickness macular holes (iFTMH) have consistent and high anatomical closure rates after vitrectomy and internal limiting membrane (ILM) peeling, regardless of iFTMH diameters. However, there is no systematic analysis examining the relationship between iFTMH diameters and anatomical closure rates.

pmc-11488231.title: The role of parental consanguinity and familial aggregation in development of multiple sclerosis: a case–control study
pmc-11488231.creator: Saeed Vaheb, Mohammad Yazdan Panah, Alireza Afshari-Safavi, Elham Moases Ghaffary, Aysa Shaygannejad, Vahid Shaygannejad, Omid Mirmosayyeb
pmc-11488231.description: BackgroundSeveral studies pointed out the importance of genetic risk factors such as parental consanguinity (PC) and familial multiple sclerosis (FMS) in the risk of MS. This study aimed to investigate the PC and FMS among people with MS (pwMS) in Isfahan, Iran.MethodsThis case–control study was conducted on pwMS from the MS clinic of Kashani Hospital, Isfahan, Iran, in October 2023.

pmc-12595084.title: Physical activity levels may impact on the risk of premature mortality in people with epilepsy
pmc-12595084.creator: Lingjie Fan, Shengyi Liu, Junhan Zhao, Xiyue Wang, Yanyi Nie, Farah Qaderi, Qibo Su, Zihua He, Sen Yang, Tong Yi, Jiaqi Wang, Cairong Zhu, Josemir W. Sander, Dong Zhou, Tao Lin, Jinmei Li
pmc-12595084.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Epilepsy affects over 70 million individuals worldwide, with optimal physical activity (PA) levels remaining challenging to determine due to potential negative outcomes from both insufficient and excessive activity. To quantify the associations between objective PA and mortality in people with epilepsy, we analyzed accelerometer data from 98,561 UK Biobank participants, including 1167 with epilepsy, to quantify associations between objectively measured PA and mortality.

pmc-12679249.title: Role of human umbilical cord mesenchymal stem cells in diabetic kidney disease
pmc-12679249.creator: Yan Liu, Xiao-Qian Shan, Yu-Jiao Li, Wei-Li Gao, Lan Zhao
pmc-12679249.description: One of the most prevalent long-term effects of diabetes is diabetic kidney disease (DKD), which is linked to problems with the metabolism of amino acids, fats, and carbohydrates. The fundamental pathogenic mechanisms of DKD cannot be adequately treated by current clinical medicines; they can only slow the illness’s progression to end-stage renal disease.

pmc-13065988.title: Irinotecan with trifluridine/tipiracil and bevacizumab for second-line metastatic colorectal cancer: a phase II multicenter study
pmc-13065988.creator: Wenwei Yang, Jing Zhang, Ping Liang, Zhaoye Qian, Donghui Wang, Wen Zhang, Baoqi Li, Chengxu Cui, Xiaomin Zhong, Guifu Wu, Yongkun Sun
pmc-13065988.description: Patients diagnosed with metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) face a constrained therapeutic landscape following the failure of initial treatment. This multicenter, single-arm, phase II trial (NCT06202001) aimed to assess the efficacy and safety of a novel second-line regimen comprising trifluridine/tipiracil (TAS-102), irinotecan, and bevacizumab. Patients with mCRC resistant to prior fluoropyrimidine and oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy were enrolled.

pmc-13187899.title: Bottlebrush anthocyanin-mediated green synthesis of ZnO nanoparticles and their integration into functional paper for multifunctional ammonia sensing and food quality monitoring
pmc-13187899.creator: Arati Dubey, Juhi, Poonam Sharma, Avanish Shukla, Adhish Jaiswal, Lebogang Katata-Seru, Indra Bahadur
pmc-13187899.description: Green synthesis has garnered significant attention in recent years due to its sustainable and environment friendly approach to nanoparticle production. Numerous studies have explored the use of plant extracts as both reducing and stabilizing agents in the synthesis of zinc oxide (ZnO) nanoparticles (NPs).

pmc-13279903.title: Geospatial dataset of oil wells and socio-environmental vulnerability indicators in coastal urban territories
pmc-13279903.creator: David Freire, Paulo Escandón-Panchana, Jorge Magallanes-Tomalá, Andrés Velastegui-Montoya, Jenny Escandón-Panchana

pmc-13365835.title: Spontaneous bilateral renal subcapsular hematoma presenting with reversible Page kidney hypertension: a case report
pmc-13365835.creator: Zhaoxing Zhan, Qingrui Li, Nueraili Paierhati, Xinsheng Zhu, Tuo Zhou, Jianhao Sun, Nueraihemaiti Yimingniyizi
pmc-13365835.description: Spontaneous bilateral renal subcapsular hematoma (SRSH) is a rare condition, especially in young individuals. We report a 25-year-old Asian female presenting with acute bilateral flank pain and new-onset hypertension. Contrast-enhanced CT revealed bilateral SRSH without an identifiable cause. The hypertension, consistent with the Page kidney phenomenon, resolved within five days under conservative management. Follow-up imaging confirmed complete hematoma resolution.
